items.q: In the lateral nasal wall cross-section, where does the nasolacrimal duct terminate and drain?
items.exp: The nasolacrimal duct opens into the inferior meatus beneath the inferior nasal concha, guarded by the mucosal fold known as the valve of Hasner. The middle meatus receives the frontal, maxillary, and anterior ethmoidal sinuses; the superior meatus receives posterior ethmoidal air cells; and the sphenoethmoidal recess receives the sphenoid sinus.
r: Incorrect. Sphenoid sinus drains into the sphenoethmoidal recess.
Incorrect. Posterior ethmoidal air cells drain into superior meatus.
Incorrect. Frontal and maxillary sinuses drain into middle meatus.
Correct. The nasolacrimal duct drains into the inferior meatus under the valve of Hasner.
items.kp: Nasolacrimal duct drains into the inferior meatus beneath the inferior concha.
